GeneDef.label: high dahn (1st-2nd)
GeneDef.description: A highprince or member of the royal household. The highest echelon of lighteyed society. They command armies, hold territory, and answer only to the crown. Manual labor is beneath their station.

GeneDef.label: mid dahn (3rd-5th)
GeneDef.description: A military officer, lesser noble, or established lighteyed house. Respected and influential, though not untouchable. Manual labor is beneath them, but necessity sometimes overrules propriety.

GeneDef.label: low dahn (6th-10th)
GeneDef.description: A minor lighteyes with little land or influence. The distinction between a tenth dahn lighteyes and a first nahn darkeyes is razor-thin. Status is technically higher, but respect must still be earned.
